{"step":4,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_exec","line":900,"var":"re","code":"re = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, options, MBREX(current_mbctype), MBREX(regex_default_syntax));","note":"Compilation is the key entry point where the vulnerable AST analysis and error cleanup run."},
{"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5458,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"The compiler's recursive analysis is invoked while building the regex AST, and malformed constructs can perturb this path."},
{"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"static enum BodyEmptyType quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"This recursive AST walk is the suspected root cause path from the crash report, matching the reported state names."},
{"step":7,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg)","line":0,"var":"mb_regs","code":"if (Z_TYPE_P(zv) == IS_ARRAY) { zend_hash_clean(Z_ARRVAL_P(zv)); }","note":"The registers output array is cleaned and repopulated, so a cleanup bug here could expose stale memory."},
{"step":8,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg)","line":0,"var":"MBREX(search_re)","code":"On compile failure, mbregex error handling must unwind partially built state","note":"The bug report indicates the crash occurs during compile-error cleanup, not normal matching."},
{"step":9,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg)","line":0,"var":"return_value","code":"mb_ereg returns after compile error handling","note":"If the cleanup path is buggy, the memory-safety sink is reached before PHP can return the warning."}
]

print('trace updated')
